BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to aquatic lands; adding new sections to chapter79.105 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 79.105 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A city with a population of five hundred thousand or greater hassixty days from the effective date of this section to negotiate a leaseof aquatic lands with the department. If the city fails to negotiatethe lease of aquatic lands, the department may: (1) Impose the lease conditions of a county with a population ofone million or greater; or (2) Enforce the provisions of section 2 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 79.105 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A city with a population of five hundred thousand or greatermust agree to all department lease conditions for leased aquatic landsor the department must cancel the lease and put the lease up for bid. p. 1 SB 6535 (2) If a city with a population of five hundred thousand or greaterfails to vacate the leased aquatic lands within thirty days of thelease cancellation, then the department must assess a one thousanddollar per day penalty on the city, with the funds going into theaquatic lands enhancement account, created in RCW 79.105.150. (3) The city is fully liable for all damages to the aquatic lands,including past environmental damage, thirty days after failure tovacate the leased lands. (4) The department shall submit a report to the legislature byJanuary 1, 2007, reporting on the status of this act in order to ensurethat the intent of the legislature is carried out.
